slides.headline: 6 PROMPTS THAT REPLACE YOUR $8,000 WEB AGENCY AND FEEL ILLEGAL
slides.image_prompt: Dario Amodei beaming triumphant, paint-splattered coveralls, holding dripping orange roller. Plain grey background. Anthropic logo. Chest-high, flash-lit, maximum clarity.

slides.headline: 1) FIND EVERY REASON CUSTOMERS LEAVE YOUR HOMEPAGE
slides.body: A copywriter charges $1,500 for a homepage audit. Prompt: "Here is my homepage copy: [paste]. List every reason a visitor clicks away, then rewrite the opening paragraph to answer their biggest objection first."

slides.headline: 2) REWRITE YOUR HERO HEADLINE IN 30 SECONDS
slides.body: Web agencies charge $2,000 to rewrite one headline. Prompt: "My business: [describe]. My client's biggest problem: [describe]. Write 10 hero headlines, every one opens with the customer's outcome, not what I sell."
slides.image_prompt: Laptop screen close-up: a dull grey headline bar crossed out in red, below it a bold electric-blue replacement bar glowing. A stopwatch symbol showing 0:30 in corner. No readable text. Dark background. Documentary news photo, harsh flash, film grain. Accent: electric blue against grey.

slides.headline: 3) TURN A 5-STAR REVIEW INTO A CASE STUDY THAT CLOSES DEALS
slides.body: Copywriters charge $500 to $2,000 for one case study. Prompt: "Here is a 5-star review: [paste]. Expand into a 250-word case study, headline: their result, body: before, what we did, one specific outcome."
slides.image_prompt: Close-up of hands holding a printed card bearing five bright gold stars, beside a glowing golden folder icon radiating light. Dark background. No readable text. Documentary news photo, harsh flash, film grain. Accent: gold stars against black.

slides.headline: 4) WRITE 20 GOOGLE PREVIEWS FOR YOUR SITE IN 2 MINUTES
slides.body: SEO agencies charge $75 per page, 20 pages runs $1,500. Prompt: "Here are 20 pages with titles: [list]. Write a 155-character Google preview for each, topic, one benefit, soft call to action."

slides.headline: 5) BUILD A FAQ PAGE THAT REMOVES EVERY EXCUSE NOT TO BUY
slides.body: Business owners answer the same 5 questions every week. Prompt: "Here are 10 pre-sale questions: [list]. Write a FAQ, each answer is 3 sentences: concern, a client result, and a reassurance."

slides.headline: 6) REWRITE YOUR ABOUT PAGE SO CUSTOMERS TRUST YOU IN 30 SECONDS
slides.body: Your About page is the second most visited page on your site. Prompt: "Here is my About page: [paste]. Rewrite, open with my customer's problem, then explain who I am. Under 350 words."

slides.headline: SAVE THIS BEFORE YOU CLOSE IT
slides.body: You will want these the next time you sit down to work on your website. Daily AI news and real skills, follow @yaffeai

caption:
Swipe through for 6 copy-paste AI prompts that audit, rewrite, and fix your website tonight. 💻

Slide 1 finds every reason a visitor leaves your homepage and rewrites the opening to stop them, slide 2 generates 10 hero headlines starting with your customer's result instead of your service name, slide 3 expands a five-star review into a full case study that closes leads, slide 4 writes 20 Google search previews for your pages in two minutes, slide 5 builds a FAQ page from your most common pre-sale questions so those emails stop, and slide 6 rewrites your About page so it opens with the customer's problem instead of your bio.

Web agencies charge $5,000 to $15,000 for a site audit and copy rewrite. Opus 5 does the same work in an afternoon, on your real copy, with nothing to install.
Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this could do for yours.

Sources: Anthropic
